metaDescription: Kevin breaks down the Dark Brandon Joe Biden meme from a marketing view, calling it funny and effective clapback but too little, too late.
summary: This video is Kevin's marketing analysis of the Dark Brandon meme used by Joe Biden's communications team in February 2024. Kevin describes the laser-eyed image posted after the Super Bowl and its reuse after Donald Trump's sneaker convention appearance. He calls the clapback content witty and brilliant but dated, noting laser eyes peaked in crypto culture. Kevin says it is an attempt to reach younger voters but argues it cannot offset Biden's age. He says he is neither right nor left and hopes the young communications team keeps posting.

keyMoments.label: Too Little, Too Late For Biden
